notes: Rivals (design v3, MVP-light). Each signature fighter stores how his last fight with the player ended. Before a rematch, show one preFight line from byFighter[fighterId][outcome] (fall back to generic[outcome]). Outcomes are from the RIVAL's side. Offer a rematch (rematchOffers) when the rival lost close or it was a draw; titleRematch and revenge are optional extras. Rematch offers obey the engine's opponent repeat cap: offer one only if the player has faced that fighter fewer than 2 times before his first title shot (titleRematch after a title fight is exempt, since title fights sit outside the pre-title cap). Rival memory is one stored outcome per signature fighter (the most recent), so no extra save fields are needed.

outcomes.lostByFinish: Player beat the rival by KO or TKO.
outcomes.lostBySubmission: Player beat the rival by submission.
outcomes.lostByDecision: Player beat the rival by unanimous decision.
outcomes.lostClose: Player beat the rival by split or majority decision (triggers a rematch offer).
outcomes.beatPlayer: Rival beat the player by any method.
outcomes.draw: Fight was a draw (triggers a rematch offer).

placeholders.lastMethod: Lowercase method of their last fight (ui.json labels.methodsInline), e.g. "split decision".
placeholders.lastEventName: Event name of their last fight.
placeholders.eventName: Event name of the offered rematch.

lostByFinish.text: Last time you got lucky, {fighterLast}. Lightning doesn't strike twice.
I've watched that knockout a hundred times. I know exactly what I did wrong.
You put me to sleep once. I've been awake ever since.

lostBySubmission.text: You caught me last time. I've spent every day since learning that escape.
I tapped once. It won't happen again.
You got my neck last time. This time you get nothing.

lostByDecision.text: The judges gave it to you. I'm not leaving it to them this time.
You won on points. I'm here to take points off your face.
Three judges liked you. Nobody else did.

lostClose.text: Everybody watching knows I won that fight.
Split decision? Let's make it a clean one this time.
One judge got it right. Tonight, I'll make it obvious.

beatPlayer.text: I beat you once. I'll do it again, just faster.
You really want another round of that?
I remember you. You remember me too. I can tell.

draw.text: Nobody won last time. That changes tonight.
Half a win doesn't feel like anything. Let's finish it.
We go again, and this time somebody leaves with it.

lostByFinish.text: You dropped me. Fine. Tonight I'm taking your legs first.

lostBySubmission.text: You choked me. Tonight, you can't grapple if you can't stand.

lostByDecision.text: You ran for three rounds. Stand still this time.

lostClose.text: My shins remember you. So will your legs.

beatPlayer.text: How's the leg? Still limping? Good. Now get out of my way. Aslanov owes me a rematch.

draw.text: A draw is a fight nobody finished. I finish things.

lostByFinish.text: You clocked me early. I'm working a full shift tonight.

lostBySubmission.text: You got the tap. I've got a guillotine with your name on it.

lostByDecision.text: I'll throw twice as many this time. Count 'em.

lostClose.text: I out-worked you and you know it. Let's run the shift back.

beatPlayer.text: Remember the guillotine? Go ahead and shoot again.

draw.text: Overtime shift. I'm used to those.

lostByFinish.text: You know, the last man who beat me, I beat in the rematch. Just so you know how this goes.

lostBySubmission.text: You caught me. Very good! I laughed the whole drive home. Then I trained.

lostByDecision.text: Brandsma beat me on points once too. Ask him how the rematch went.

lostClose.text: Close fight, nice fight, I bought you a coffee. Now I want my belt back.

beatPlayer.text: Last time you saw the lights. Okafor and Marchetti can tell you, they're nice lights.

draw.text: A draw? In the harbor we call that unfinished work.

lostByFinish.text: You caught me clean. Genuinely impressive. I'd hate for it to become a habit.

lostBySubmission.text: Rolling on the floor again. I've had quite enough of that from Aslanov, thank you.

lostByDecision.text: The judges preferred you. They're entitled to their opinion. I'll correct it.

lostClose.text: Two judges saw it your way. Lovely people. I sent them flowers. Rematch?

beatPlayer.text: Welcome back. Please, rush me the same way. I've been looking forward to it.

draw.text: A draw. How civilized. Shall we be uncivilized this time?

lostByFinish.text: You caught me coming in. I'm still coming in. Just lower.

lostBySubmission.text: You tied me up. Nobody ties me up. I'll be heavier this time.

lostByDecision.text: You ran for three rounds. Heavyweights shouldn't run. It's embarrassing for both of us.

lostClose.text: One more grip and it was mine. This time I don't let go.

beatPlayer.text: Remember the body lock? Your back does.

draw.text: Even? Fine. Then we grind until somebody isn't.

lostByFinish.text: You found the chin. Took you long enough. I've hidden it better.

lostBySubmission.text: You tied an old man in a knot. Won't fall for that twice.

lostByDecision.text: Judges like dancing. I'll just keep walking you down.

lostClose.text: You got the nod, kid. I got the long walk forward. Again.

beatPlayer.text: I've got more jabs in this left hand than you've got answers.

draw.text: Even? At my age, I'll take that as a win. But I'd like a real one.

lostByFinish.text: You got inside once. I've made my arms longer. Just kidding. Kind of.

lostBySubmission.text: You pulled me down to your level. Tonight I stay up here.

lostByDecision.text: You survived the distance. That's all you did.

lostClose.text: Close fights don't count up here. I'm finishing this one.

draw.text: We split it down the middle. My half is longer.

lostByFinish.text: You hit hard. But tonight, I'm behind you. You can't hit behind you.

lostBySubmission.text: You submitted me. Nobody does that. I want to know how you did it, and then I want it back.

lostByDecision.text: You kept me off your back. Can you do it again?

lostClose.text: One more scramble and it was mine. Tonight we scramble all night.

beatPlayer.text: Your neck remembers me. So will the kid's, when Salgado finally gets his shot.

draw.text: The coil never finished squeezing. Tonight it does.

lostByFinish.text: You caught me once. I've gotten faster since. Way faster.

lostBySubmission.text: You took me down and caught me. Tonight you won't catch anything.

lostByDecision.text: The judges didn't count right. I'm throwing a thousand this time.

lostClose.text: I'm twenty-one. I've got all the time in the world to beat you.

beatPlayer.text: Did you count them last time? 'Cause I didn't.

draw.text: A tie? Nah. I need a winner and I know who.

lostByFinish.text: You knocked me out and my mom yelled at me. Now I'm mad. Reyes is next, right after you.

lostBySubmission.text: You tapped me. I learned that move on the drive home.

lostByDecision.text: You beat me on points. I'm still a teenager. I'm getting better every week.

lostClose.text: Split decision? I'm writing my rematch essay right now.

beatPlayer.text: Tapped by a kid. How was your summer?

draw.text: A draw? That's like getting a C. I want an A.

lostClose.title: Rematch Demanded
lostClose.text: {rival} hasn't stopped talking about the {lastMethod} at {lastEventName}. The {promotionShort} wants to run it back at {eventName}. Purse: {purse}.

lostClose.title: Unfinished Business
lostClose.text: "I won that fight," says {rival}. The fans want to see it again, and so does the {promotionShort}. {eventName}, {weeksLabel} out.

lostClose.title: Run It Back
lostClose.text: Your {lastMethod} over {rival} split the fans down the middle. Settle it at {eventName}.

draw.title: Settle It
draw.text: Nobody won at {lastEventName}. {rival} wants a winner this time. {eventName}, purse {purse}.

draw.title: Tiebreaker
draw.text: The {promotionShort} is booking the tiebreaker: {fighter} vs. {rival} II at {eventName}.

titleRematch.title: Immediate Rematch
titleRematch.text: {rival} wants the belt back, and the {promotionShort} agrees. Title rematch at {eventName}.

titleRematch.title: Second Chance
titleRematch.text: You took the title from {rival} by {lastMethod}. Now {rival} gets one shot to take it back.

revenge.title: Revenge Opportunity
revenge.text: {rival} beat you by {lastMethod} at {lastEventName}. Want it back? {eventName}, purse {purse}.

revenge.title: Payback
revenge.text: {rival} is on the card at {eventName}, and the {promotionShort} remembers your last fight. So do you.

rivalDeclines.title: Not Interested
rivalDeclines.text: {rival} says he's moved on. Your manager says that means he's scared.

rivalDeclines.title: No Rematch
rivalDeclines.text: {rival}'s team turned down the rematch. Keep winning and they won't have a choice.

grudgesNote: Static storyline between signature fighters (not player memory). Show a grudge line as flavor when the player is booked against either fighter in a pair, in the build-up to a title fight against the champion in that pair, or after the player beats one of them (the other reacts). Needs no new save data. The prefix (OKAFOR:, etc.) names the speaker; strip it if the UI shows a portrait.

aslanovOkafor.history: Aslanov beat Okafor by unanimous decision, throwing him from the clinch every round. Okafor wants the rematch.

lines.text: OKAFOR: Every time I kicked, he caught me in the clinch and threw me. I've been drilling the break ever since.
ASLANOV: Dante kicks very hard. I know because I was holding the leg.
OKAFOR: Beat him for me. Or beat me, then I'll do it myself.
OKAFOR: He lost once and won the rematch. That's exactly what I plan to do to him.

aslanovMarchetti.history: Aslanov threw Marchetti from a body lock and submitted him from top. Marchetti hasn't forgiven the mat.

lines.text: MARCHETTI: Timur is a lovely man. I would simply prefer never to be underneath him again.
ASLANOV: Lucien talks so politely, even when he taps.
MARCHETTI: If you see a way past the body lock, do write it down for me.

reyesSalgado.history: Salgado is the teen contender hunting veteran champion Reyes. They haven't fought yet.

lines.text: SALGADO: Reyes is great. Was great. Past tense is coming.
REYES: The kid is very talented. He should enjoy being nineteen. It goes quickly.
SALGADO: Beat him before I do? Sure. Then I beat you.

dorseyHollander.history: Hollander thinks Dorsey has held the middleweight belt too long.

lines.text: HOLLANDER: Hank's had that belt since before phones had cameras. Time to share.
DORSEY: The kid can call me old all he wants. I'm still here, aren't I?

valeLind.history: Reach vs. grip: tall, spinning striker Vale against squat wrestler-brawler Lind.

lines.text: LIND: He spins a lot. Eventually he spins into my arms.
VALE: Oskar's built like a mailbox. I'll kick it over.
